node_herb_bed.name: herb bed
node_herb_bed.description: A tended patch of fragrant herbs. Careful cutting will leave enough for it to recover.

node_berry_bramble.name: berry bramble
node_berry_bramble.description: A thorny bramble heavy with berries and a few useful wild herbs growing at its base.

node_fallen_bough.name: fallen bough
node_fallen_bough.description: A storm-fallen bough with several sound lengths of wood still worth cutting free.

node_river_clay_bank.name: river clay bank
node_river_clay_bank.description: A sheltered bank where the slow river has left a workable seam of fine clay.

node_rose_quartz_seam.name: rose quartz seam
node_rose_quartz_seam.description: A blush-pink seam of crystal runs through the weathered rock. A careful prospector could prise loose a few intact pieces.
